# Verb + 緊 · *Verb + gan2*

**Meaning:** in the middle of doing (-ing) · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Time and aspect

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fgan2-progressive).

Add 緊 straight after a verb to say an action is happening right now, like English '-ing'.

**Written Chinese:** 正在… — Written Chinese uses 正在 before the verb.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我食緊飯。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 sik6 gan2 faan6. |
| Yale | ngóh sihk gán faahn. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄍㄜㄣ² ㄈㄚㄣ⁶. |
| English | I'm eating. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢講緊電話。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 gong2 gan2 din6 waa2. |
| Yale | kéuih góng gán dihn wá. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄍㄛㄥ² ㄍㄜㄣ² ㄉㄧㄣ⁶ ㄨㄚ². |
| English | She's on the phone. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **外面落緊雨。** |
| Jyutping | ngoi6 min6 lok6 gan2 jyu5. |
| Yale | ngoih mihn lohk gán yúh. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛㄧ⁶ ㄇㄧㄣ⁶ ㄌㄛㆶ⁶ ㄍㄜㄣ² ㄩ⁵. |
| English | It's raining outside. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢哋開緊會。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 dei6 hoi1 gan2 wui2. |
| Yale | kéuih deih hōi gán wúi. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄉㄝㄧ⁶ ㄏㄛㄧ¹ ㄍㄜㄣ² ㄨㄨㄧ². |
| English | They're in a meeting. |
